_description: Public default priority config. Produces eight named, priority-ordered sheets: six FlyBase curated-phenotype buckets followed by Bloomington RNAi Ref++ and Ref+ buckets. Each (stock_id, collection) reagent lands in only the first matching sheet. Phenotype evidence is included whenever a Phenotype filter is active; embeddings only add cosine scores.
_how_to_use: Build a combination by listing reusable filter names from `filters`. Collection filters select a stock center; reagent-class filters select RNAi or non-RNAi reagents; evidence filters select phenotype or publication tiers; structure filters select CRISPR, balancer, or insertion status. Combinations are evaluated top-to-bottom and the first match wins. `maxStocksPerGene` and `maxStocksPerAllele` are shared across all sheets, so the six phenotype sheets can consume a gene's cap before either Ref sheet is reached.
_filter_catalog_notes: Every entry in `filters` is a valid reusable ingredient. An ingredient may be absent from `combinations` (for example Ref- or No Balancers) so users can compose a custom sheet without adding unsupported filter types. Do not add explanatory keys inside `filters`: the loader treats every key there as an executable filter specification.

_combination_notes.BDSC·RNAi·Pheno: Highest-priority Bloomington RNAi reagents with any curated FlyBase phenotype.
_combination_notes.VDRC·RNAi·Pheno: Vienna RNAi reagents with any curated FlyBase phenotype.
_combination_notes.BDSC·Allele·Pheno: Bloomington non-RNAi allele/insertion reagents with any curated FlyBase phenotype.
_combination_notes.OtherSC·Allele·Pheno: Orderable non-Bloomington non-RNAi allele/insertion reagents with any curated FlyBase phenotype.
_combination_notes.Custom·RNAi·Pheno: Custom, non-orderable RNAi reagents with curated FlyBase phenotype evidence.
_combination_notes.Custom·Allele·Pheno: Custom, non-orderable non-RNAi reagents with curated FlyBase phenotype evidence.
_combination_notes.BDSC·RNAi·Ref++: Bloomington RNAi reagents with a title/abstract hit for at least one configured search term, after phenotype buckets claim their matches.
_combination_notes.BDSC·RNAi·Ref+: Bloomington RNAi reagents with cited publications but no configured title/abstract keyword hit, after phenotype and Ref++ buckets claim their matches.

_column_notes.collection: FlyBase stock collection name, e.g. Bloomington, Vienna, Kyoto.
_column_notes.RNAi: COMPUTED: Broad UAS/RNAi proxy. True if genotype contains UAS or RNAi, if a Vienna stock matches VDRC knockdown families such as GD, KK, or VSH, or if construct metadata marks it as an RNAi reagent. Used by AlleleOrInsertion and UAS filters.
_column_notes.transgenic_product_class_terms: FlyBase transgenic product class terms for the stock. RNAi_reagent filter matches when this field contains 'RNAi_reagent'.
_column_notes.custom_stock: COMPUTED: True for phenotype-backed reagents without an orderable FBst stock-center record. Drives Stock Center vs Non Stock Center filters.
_column_notes.AlleleOrInsertion: CONFIG ALIAS: Implemented as RNAi == false, matching the non-UAS shorthand.
_column_notes.sgRNA: COMPUTED: True if stock genotype contains 'sgRNA' (case-insensitive). No sgRNA filter excludes CRISPR reagents from the Ref matrix.
_column_notes.num_Balancers: COMPUTED: Number of FBba (balancer) components associated with the stock. Drives No Balancers / Has Balancers filters.
_column_notes.multiple_insertions: COMPUTED: True if stock has more than one unique transgenic construct. Drives no_other_insertion / other_insertion filters.
_column_notes.genotype: FlyBase stock genotype text. It is the source for the computed sgRNA and broad RNAi flags; filter it with contains or doesnt_contain only when an exact string-based rule is appropriate.
_column_notes.ALLELE_PAPER_RELEVANCE_SCORE: COMPUTED: 0 (Ref-)=no refs, 1 (Ref+)=has refs but none contain keywords in title/abstract, 2 (Ref++)=at least 1 ref has case-insensitive keyword hit in title/abstract.
_column_notes.PHENOTYPE_RELEVANCE_SCORE: COMPUTED: 0=no curated phenotype, 1 (Phenotype+)=has curated phenotype but none match phenotypeSimilarityTargets, 2 (Phenotype++)=curated phenotype matches a target. Phenotype filter qualifies when score is non-zero.

_settings_notes.input.geneCol: Required column in the reviewed input CSV that contains FlyBase gene IDs.
_settings_notes.input.inputGeneCol: Required input CSV column preserved as the human-facing gene-symbol label.
_settings_notes.input.skipFbgnidConversion: True means the input has already passed scripts/fetch_fbgn_ids.py review; false requests the conversion sidecar before Stage 1.
_settings_notes.pubmed.batchSize: Positive batch size for PubMed and full-text metadata requests.
_settings_notes.relevantSearchTerms: Case-insensitive title/abstract terms defining Ref++, Ref+, and Ref- publication evidence.
_settings_notes.phenotypeSimilarityTargets: Required {keyword, embedding_text} target list for phenotype relevance tiers and optional OpenAI cosine scoring.
_settings_notes.maxStocksPerGene: Maximum selected stock rows per input gene across every combination, applied in priority order.
_settings_notes.maxStocksPerAllele: Maximum selected stock rows per allele across every combination, applied in priority order.
_settings_notes.validation.enabled: Enables GPT functional validation for eligible Ref++ output stocks when OPENAI_API_KEY is set.
_settings_notes.validation.maxGptCallsPerStock: Maximum validation-paper calls per stock; null means no cap.
_settings_notes.validation.minFullTextChars: Minimum recovered full-text character count required before GPT validation.
_settings_notes.validation.shortCircuitOnFunctionalValid: Stops validation for a stock after the first functional hit.
_settings_notes.validation.enableGptLogging: Writes GPT validation request/response logs when true.
_settings_notes.embeddings.enabled: Adds optional OpenAI phenotype cosine-similarity scores. It does not control phenotype or GAL4 evidence capture.
_settings_notes.output.preserveUnsplitWorkbook: Preserves the intermediate Stage 1 workbook when true.
_settings_notes.contentsSeparatorEvery: Number of Contents-sheet breakdown rows between faint visual separators.

filterDescriptions.Bloomington: Stocks from the Bloomington collection in FlyBase.
filterDescriptions.Vienna: Stocks from the Vienna (VDRC) collection in FlyBase.
filterDescriptions.Stock Center: Orderable stock-center rows with an FBst-backed stock record.
filterDescriptions.Non Stock Center: Phenotype-backed custom reagents without an orderable stock-center record.
filterDescriptions.RNAi_reagent: FlyBase marks the stock as an RNAi reagent (transgenic_product_class_terms contains RNAi_reagent). Used in phenotype buckets and the Bloomington Ref matrix.
filterDescriptions.UAS: UAS bucket. Uses the repo's broad UAS/RNAi proxy rather than a narrower genotype-only UAS check. Defined but not referenced by current combinations.
filterDescriptions.AlleleOrInsertion: Non-UAS bucket. Implemented as rows that do not match the broad UAS/RNAi proxy.
filterDescriptions.Phenotype: Stocks with any associated curated FlyBase phenotype (PHENOTYPE_RELEVANCE_SCORE != 0; Phenotype+ or Phenotype++).
filterDescriptions.Ref++: Allele has at least one publication whose title or abstract contains a configured keyword (case-insensitive).
filterDescriptions.Ref+: Allele has publications, but none contain a configured keyword in title or abstract.
filterDescriptions.No sgRNA: Genotype does not include sgRNA (excludes CRISPR reagents from the Ref matrix).
filterDescriptions.Has Balancers: One or more balancer components (FBba) are associated with the stock (num_Balancers > 0).
filterDescriptions.No Balancers: No balancer components (FBba) are associated with the stock (num_Balancers = 0).
filterDescriptions.other_insertion: Stock has more than one unique transgenic construct.
filterDescriptions.no_other_insertion: Stock has only one unique transgenic construct (single insertion).
